environment.description: Spring Boot 2.7.x application deployed on EC2 behind an Application Load Balancer with public DNS. The ALB forwards all traffic on port 443 directly to the application on port 8080. No WAF is attached. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. The application serves HTML fragments consumed by a React SPA on the same origin.

config.origin_access: direct HTTP access to origin allowed
